_comment: First-session tutorial. target: where the pointing hand goes. wait: event that completes the step.

steps.text: Welcome to Cozy Acres, {name}! This little farm is all yours. Let's grow something!
Tap an empty field to plant.
Pick Wheat. Then tap or swipe across fields to plant them all!
Wheat takes 30 seconds. Meanwhile, tap the Order Board to see what villagers want.
Orders pay coins and XP. Let's grow the wheat for this one!
When the wheat turns golden, swipe across the fields to harvest it.
Now open the Order Board and deliver an order.
Great! Open the Shop to build more fields.
Pick a Field, drag it where you like and tap the tick.
You're a natural! Follow the goal card at the top left whenever you're unsure what to do next. Have fun!
